ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed for your profile photo.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Calendar access is needed to import your events as time blocks.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Access is needed to read your calendar reminders.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: LifeOS reads steps, distance, active energy, workouts, sleep, heart rate and weight from Apple Health to build your daily health summary, goal progress, activity-based calorie budget, weekly insights, recovery suggestions and a calorie target based on your weight trend.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: LifeOS only reads health data and never writes anything.
